newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent technicals push thin market higher.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent technicals push thin market higher.

text.p: IPE Brent crude oil futures were firmer on Tuesday in what traders and brokers said was a technical bounce following recent sharp falls.
May Brent was 21 cents a barrel firmer at 1156 GMT and stood at $17.98, while April gas oil was 75 cents a tonne firmer at $162.75.
April gas oil, which expires on Thursday, lay in a $1.00 contango to May.
"It is very quiet and very thin and is easily pushed around."
Dealers expected $18 to be the next upwards technical hurdle to break, before the market encounters a strong band of resistance at a recent chart gap between $18.40 and $18.50.
Support lies at the level of Friday's low at $17.65.
Gas oil is still supported by last month's lows and traders said it would be hard for the contract to break underneath $160 a barrel.
MeesPierson Derivatives said in a daily report: "A break to the downside at $160.50 and we go with the flow. Alternatively, if we get to $163.50, sell out."
-- Nicholas Shaxson, London newsroom +44 171 542 8167 (c) Reuters Limited 1997
